a.lede: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.
a.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years

b.lede: X is finally rolling out parental controls that allow parents and guardians to manage teens' accounts on the platform. b.title: X is finally getting its first parental controls
